headline: #BREAKING: Nearly three decades after the passing of hiphop icon #TupacShakur, Duane #KeffeD Davis has been found guilty of his murder.
body: #BREAKING: Nearly three decades after the passing of hiphop icon #TupacShakur, Duane #KeffeD Davis has been found guilty of his murder. He was accused of plotting the tragedy that occurred on September 13, 1996. Today he has been found guilty of first degree murder. His sentencing will take place on October 13th. (: @gettyimages) 🏾: #TSRStaffST The charges and accusations are allegations; every defendant is presumed innocent unless proven guilty in court.
